title: MOSS-Image Base (int8)
about: MOSS-Image Base, int8. Base is not preference-tuned and wants long, concrete prompts. ✨ Enhance prompt (LLM) on the Render is off: switched on, the 9B text encoder rewrites a short idea into a full caption first (moodier, more cinematic frames in a 20-image check), but it can drop specific details (it closed a pocket watch over its dial and turned coloured anime into line art). ER-SDE 25 steps, cfg 3 (8 s per 1024² image on a 5090); 50 steps took twice as long and looked no better in a 20-pair check. No turbo merged in: the Turbo chip adds a turbo LoRA (Kromoss DMD2 8-step suits Base) or switch to the SFT DeBand card for DeBand Fast. Base has no banding.

title: MOSS-Image SFT DeBand (int8)
about: MOSS-Image SFT with the banding fix merged in (DeBand), int8, with Dylan's graph: Temporal Score Rescaling 0.95 / 1.0 and skip-layer guidance on single blocks 22, 24 from 10 to 70 %, ER-SDE 25 steps, cfg 3. Dylan's graph runs core's SamplerER_SDE at s_noise 1.05; this card uses KSamplerSelect's er_sde (s_noise 1.0) until the image Render takes a sampler, and 20 pairs looked the same either way (1.05 is grainier by the numbers). No banding in 40 images. SFT always carries a deband fix. Turbo: the DeBand Fast merge (DMD at 0.35, 10 steps) swaps the checkpoint, or add an SFT DMD / DMAD LoRA row.

title: Kromoss (int8)
about: Kromoss: lodestones' full fine-tune of MOSS-Image Base at 1024 px, int8; keep it at or under about 2.5 MP. Skip-layer guidance on layer 22 as its card says; ER-SDE 25 steps, cfg 3 (8 s per 1024² image on a 5090): the same layouts as Base, crisper, no banding seen. The Kromoss card's own Euler 50 steps is a bit smoother and may be cleaner on signs and lettering at twice the time: the "Kromoss text-heavy (Euler 50)" setup. Turbo: the Kromoss DMD2 8-step LoRA (Euler, 8 steps, cfg 1, no negative), which the community rates best on Kromoss; use one DMD LoRA at a time.

title: Kromoss text-heavy (Euler 50)
about: Kromoss with its model card's own sampling: Euler, 50 steps, cfg 3, skip-layer guidance on layer 22 (15 s per 1024² image on a 5090). Smoother than the ER-SDE 25 default and maybe cleaner on signs, posters and lettering (2 seeds of 2 text prompts); otherwise the same, at twice the time.

title: Krea 2 Raw (fp8)
about: Krea 2 Raw loaded as fp8_e4m3fn (the int8 ConvRot file is int8_rowwise, which core ComfyUI can't load), the stock Qwen3-VL 4B encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE, res_multistep with the beta schedule (0.6, 0.6), 30 steps, cfg 4: the settings the Krea dials were calibrated on. Turbo: the Krea 2 Turbo fp8 merge swaps the checkpoint (8 steps, cfg 1, ddim; its workflow's beta57 isn't in core, so beta). The Krea dials only steer toward their A side.
